title: Return a drained houseplant to its saucer on the window sill, beside another plant
instruction: The watered houseplant has drained in the sink drainer. Carry it to the window sill and set its pot down in its saucer in the tray, then let go. Leave the saucer in its bay and the other plant where it is.
context: Most adults keep a houseplant. After watering it at the sink the pot drains in the drainer, then goes back to the window sill: lifted out, carried over the sill tray's edge and set down in its saucer, so the last drips fall in the saucer and not on the wood. The pot's foot has to find the saucer's well (7 mm clear each side) and the saucer has to stay in its bay, which is what stops it being knocked off the sill. The hard part is the seat: a 58 mm foot into a 72 mm well, square to it, in a loose saucer that must not shift, with a top-heavy neighbour 14 mm away that must not be touched. The sill is crowded: another plant's canopy overhangs the next bay, so a pot set down badly or a hand swung wide knocks something. The job ends when the hand lets go and clears away.
setup: Bimanual YAM station; the table top is the reference height and stands for a kitchen worktop under a window, whose deep sill is flush with it: the plants stand at the back by the window, the sink's drainer at the front right. x points forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the left of the midpoint between them, z up; arm bases at y +30.5 cm and -30.5 cm. Six things. (1) Window: a 6 mm glass pane, 660 mm wide and 300 mm high, in a white wooden frame (rails and jambs 40 mm wide, 40 mm deep), the glass centred at x 455 mm with its lower edge 40 mm above the sill. (2) Sill tray: black polypropylene, 134 mm (x) by 266 mm (y), edge 12 mm high and 3 mm thick, floor 3 mm, centred at x 330 mm, y 0. It has two bays, each a 102 mm square marked out by stops 3 mm wide and 4 mm high on the floor, centred at y -66 mm (right bay) and y +66 mm (left bay), x 330 mm. (3) Drip saucer: square, terracotta-coloured polypropylene, 98 mm over its flared rim, 92 mm at the foot, 12 mm high, floor 3 mm, a 72 mm square well at the floor widening to 84 mm at the mouth, 0.045 kg, standing in the right bay (5 mm clear each side of its foot). (4) The other plant: an artificial plant in a saucer like (3) and a pot like (5), with an 8 mm wooden dowel stem and a round canopy of artificial leaves (or a 160 mm foam disc) 160 mm across whose lowest leaf is 150 mm over the sill; sand in the pot brings the whole plant to 0.30 kg, standing in the left bay. The canopy's edge reaches to y -14 mm, over the right bay's inner edge. (5) Plant pot: a 3 inch square nursery pot, black polypropylene, 78 mm square at the rim, 58 mm at the foot, 78 mm high, its sides stepping 58, 65 and 72 mm up to a 6 mm rim, filled with dry potting mix and topped with an artificial succulent rosette 44 mm across and 12 mm high (plastic or foam, pushed into the mix); total 0.20 kg (dry sand under the mix makes the weight, covered by a disc of card so nothing spills on the pads; no water); standing upright in the drainer. (6) Drainer: grey plastic tray, 130 mm square, edge 15 mm high, floor 3 mm, centred at x 200 mm, y -235 mm; the pot stands at its centre. The pot's foot is 58 mm and the well 72 mm. The gripper opens 94 mm; the pot is held by its middle layer, 65 mm wide. Nothing else is on the table.
scoring: End state, read at the last step from the poses of the pot, the saucer, the other plant and both grippers, plus faults over the whole trial. Seated: the pot's four foot corners lie inside the saucer's 72 mm well (1 mm allowed) and between 2 mm below and 3 mm above the well's floor; its axis is within 5 degrees of the saucer's, its sides within 10 degrees of the saucer's, and its axis within 8 mm of the saucer's axis (top view). In the bay: the saucer tilted under 3 degrees, its foot's four corners inside the bay's 102 mm square (1 mm allowed) and within 2 mm of the tray floor's height (not on a stop). Other plant undisturbed: at no moment more than 3 mm from its place in any direction (lifted included) or tilted more than 3 degrees. Hands off: for the last 1 s both grippers' finger zones 30 mm or more from the pot, the saucer and the other plant, and each of the three moves under 5 mm and turns under 5 degrees (visible motion; the GPU demo ran at 0.0 mm and 0.0 degrees). Score 0 if the pot is ever tipped more than 30 degrees from vertical, the other plant is ever tipped more than 30 degrees, or any of the three falls more than 10 mm below the table top. Otherwise: 1.0 seated, in the bay, other plant undisturbed, hands off; 0.5 seated with the saucer's centre still inside the tray's raised edge, but the saucer out of its bay, or the other plant moved or tilted (not toppled); 0 seated in a saucer whose centre is outside the tray's raised edge; 0.25 not seated, the other plant undisturbed, and the pot upright (axis within 10 degrees of vertical) with its foot's centre over the tray's outline and at most 20 mm above the table top (on the tray floor or the saucer's rim); 0 otherwise, and 0 whenever the hands are not off. Success: 1.0 held for 1 s. In a real trial, per condition: foot height, a 3 mm feeler gauge under the foot; axis, a phone level on the pot's side; sides, a try-square; saucer in bay, a 102 mm square template and a ruler; other plant, a 3 mm spacer block and a protractor; hands off, a 30 mm spacer block and the video of the last second (nothing visibly moves); tipped or fallen, a protractor and by eye.
fidelity: Rigid bodies: the pot's taper is three steps (58, 65, 72 mm), its soil and succulent are fixed in it, the saucer's slope is two steps, the other plant is one body with a rigid disc for its canopy. Friction 0.5 plastic on plastic (est). No water, no drips, no flexing leaves; the pot is dry and 0.20 kg; real trials use artificial plants. The window, tray and drainer are fixed.
reset_notes: Stand the pot upright at the centre of the drainer (x 200 mm, y -235 mm), the saucer in the right bay (centre y -66 mm) and the other plant in the left bay (centre y +66 mm), the tray centred at x 330 mm, y 0, the window glass at x 455 mm. Wipe the saucer, tray and drainer dry; the plants are artificial and dry, so nothing needs watering or draining. Nothing is consumed.
